integrity: The upper bound is an analytic Euclidean norm comparison and the equality constructions are exact trigonometric identities. The bundled checker reconstructs representative polygon norms and verifies the stated resonance geometry, but finite computation is not used as a substitute for the infinite-family proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves a global upper bound and a natural finite family of attaining parameter ratios for every regular fourfold polygon. It does not classify all equality ratios, and it does not address regular polygons whose side count is not divisible by four.
title: Facet-resonant Euler--Lagrange constants on regular \(4n\)-gonal Banach planes
